name: go-package-path-with-a-plus
description: An import path element holding a byte outside letters, digits, dot, underscore, tilde and hyphen is percent-encoded in the reference: the unexported function nothing calls in the package example.com/fixture/c++ is reported, and its finding's reference spells the element c%2B%2B. The suppression phase writes that reference into an ignore entry, and the entry binds the finding.
